items: 48V LiFePO4 golf cart battery with a BMS rated for the cart's discharge current
58.4V lithium-profile charger (the old lead-acid charger cannot be reused)
why: ChatGPT says yes, recommends LiFePO4, and warns that voltage, discharge current, BMS and charger must all match the cart, but it showed only a generic 48V 'Shop' link and no product card. Switching to lithium means swapping the lead-acid charger for a 58.4V LiFePO4 one and sizing the BMS current to the motor controller, and Redodo's 48V 100Ah conversion kit SKU puts the battery, charger and shunt monitor in one cart (Vatrer's charger-included kit fits Club Car only).
